subject: GreenWave renewal: forecast stabilization & next-step checklist
messages:
From: Emily Song <emily.song@greenwave.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal discussion + forecast update for GreenWave

Hi Michael,

Quick note as we get into Q2 planning — our CFO asked me to confirm GreenWave's intent to renew for the 12-month plan starting 2027-05-15. Usage ramped higher than expected in Q1 (see attached summary), and procurement needs a firm ARR number to include in next week's budget.

Can you confirm:
- The proposed renewal ARR and any available credits for usage overages?
- Whether we can lock pricing for 12 months if we commit by 2027-04-10?

Attaching the Q1 usage report and the latest SOW draft (v3) — I flagged a couple of small scope items that procurement will review. If it's easier, let's schedule a 20-min call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Emily Song
Head of Data Platforms
GreenWave Analytics
Attachments: usage_report_Q1.csv, GreenWave_SOW_v3.pdf
From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
To: Emily Song <emily.song@greenwave.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-01T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + forecast update for GreenWave

Emily — thanks for the data and the heads-up. Appreciate the clear asks.

High level:
- Renewal ARR: base renewal we quoted is $240,000/yr. Given the Q1 overage profile, we can offer a $12,000 one-time credit applied at renewal (conditional on signing by 2027-04-10).
- Price lock: yes — we can hold the quoted rates for 12 months if we receive a signed SOW and PO by EOD 2027-04-10.

I've looped in Ben (finops) and Marissa (CS) to confirm the customer-facing SOW edits and the credit mechanics. Ben — can you confirm the finance approval cadence and whether we need a separate discount paperwork? Marissa — can your team validate the usage tiers so we can adjust the SOW's overage language?

If helpful, I have a 20-min window at 10:30 AM PT tomorrow for a quick align with you and procurement.

Best,
Michael Grant
Head of Sales, Enterprise
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-02T08:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + forecast update for GreenWave

Adding finance context:
- The $12k one-time credit is OK under standard renewal concession guidelines. I need a short approval note from Sales to attach to the contract for audit. Michael — please put a line in Slack (#renewals) confirming the concession and reason (usage spike).
- Forecast impact: mark this opportunity as commit=true in the April forecast once signed PO is received. Until then, use a probability of 75% given procurement timelines.

Marissa — for churn risk tracking, please do a quick health check: 1) NPS/use-case health, 2) outstanding product requests, 3) support ticket backlog. If any of these are red we should flag in the renewal tracker and consider an additional success engagement.

Thanks — attaching the standard renewal concession form template for reference.

Ben Carter
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: renewal_concession_template.docx
From: Tom Hartman <tom.hartman@greenwave.ai>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Song <emily.song@greenwave.ai>, procurement@greenwave.ai
Date: 2027-04-05T16:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion + forecast update for GreenWave

Michael — thanks to you and the team for the quick turnaround. Procurement reviewed the SOW and the credit is acceptable. We're going to proceed with the 12-month renewal and will issue a PO by 2027-04-09.

Two quick items we need in the final SOW before PO:
- Explicit language on incident escalation SLAs (we suggested 24/7 P1 contact in the SOW, procurement wants the escalation path added).
- Confirmation that the one-time credit will be applied as a line-item credit on invoice #1.

I've attached the signed renewal cover page with our signature (procurement sign-off). If you can send the final SOW with the two clarifications by EOD 2027-04-06, we will process the PO.

Thanks,
Tom Hartman
VP Finance
GreenWave Analytics
Attachments: signed_renewal.pdf
